review.en: Ofra Haza, daughter of Yemenite Jewish immigrants, recorded the songs of her parents' tradition, many set to poems by the seventeenth-century poet Shalom Shabazi, with arrangements that mix traditional percussion and modern orchestration. Released abroad it found an international audience, and its song Im Nin'alu, remixed a few years later, became a hit across Europe. A bridge between family memory and the wider world.
review.zh: 奥芙拉·哈扎是也门犹太移民的女儿，她录下父母传统里的歌，许多歌词出自十七世纪诗人沙洛姆·沙巴齐，编曲把传统打击乐与现代管弦乐交织在一起。专辑在海外发行后找到了国际听众，其中《Im Nin'alu》几年后经混音，在欧洲多国走红。它连接了家族记忆和更广阔的世界。
